title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: a non-test root module edge outside exact relative contract/router imports; a root module re-export; a non-normalized relative source; a relative module edge whose normalized target leaves its closed module outside the exact module.ts-to-impl and middleware-to-base edges; a named operation leaf importing its module router; a current-owner alias containing an empty, dot, parent, or trailing segment; or a module current-owner alias outside service/model, including same-module, sibling-module, root-runtime, and legacy shared paths
why: Relative paths keep module-local ownership visible, the service-private model alias identifies genuinely service-wide inert meaning, and exact downward composition edges keep the service funnel closed without changing the Nx project graph.
remediate: Use normalized relative paths when the target stays in the current module. Use the current-owner service/model alias only for service-wide model meaning. Keep exact relative root contract/router composition, ../../impl from module.ts, and ../../../base from named module middleware. Move sibling collaboration behind a service-owned capability and move outside-system mechanics behind a resource.
message: Service modules use relative local imports, service/model aliases, and exact downward wiring only.
